text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install black isort flake8
      - name: Format Python code
        run: |
          black .
          isort .
      - name: Check Python code
        run: |
          flake8 .

  lint-cpp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Clang
        uses: apple-actions/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: 'clang-13'
      - name: Format C++ code
        run: |
          find challenges scripts -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.cu" | xargs clang-format -i

  lint-mojo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Validate Mojo code
        run: |
          # Basic validation script or command goes here
          echo "Basic validation passed."
```
